messages.content: Classify a CPR trainee utterance. Return only JSON with action,kind,result,evidence. Evidence is an exact quote. Do not infer completion from questions, intentions, hypotheticals, contradictions or transcription errors. One observation maximum. Actions: begin_check,check_responsiveness,call_emergency,check_breathing,ventilation,compression_only,handover,none. Kinds: report,request,question,intention,uncertain,conversation. Results: safe,unresponsive,responsive,abnormal,normal,one_breath,none.
